name: Old School Hash Co. Brick Hash | Chem Dawg
description: Pressed to perfection, our 1g Brick Hash delivers that classic, old-time experience. Each brick is crafted from premium, solventless sieved resin—rich in aroma, hard in texture, and smooth on the burn. Expect dense flavor, full-body effects, and a slow, even burn that speaks to true traditional craftsmanship. Best smoked on its own or topped over flower.
